name: Company
definition: Distinct legal entity, public or private; subsidiaries are Companies

name: CorporateGroup
definition: Corporate umbrella that may contain multiple legal Companies

name: OrganizationUnit
definition: Nonlegal company branch, division, or internal unit

name: ProductCategory
definition: Industry-wide product classification shared across vendors

name: Product
definition: Sellable product, hardware component, software offering or integrated solution

name: Industry
definition: Taxonomy of economic activities and end-markets

name: MarketSegment
definition: Specific group of buyers sharing application and purchasing need, optionally by region

name: SupplyRelationship
definition: Documented commercial supply relationship relating seller, buyer, product

name: CustomerOpportunity
definition: Prospective customer opportunity, not a verified sale

name: Collaboration
definition: Partnership, joint venture, MOU, integration or joint development

name: CompetitionAssessment
definition: Scoped competitive assessment of two products in a market

name: Evidence
definition: Original filing, product page, announcement, contract, or independent source

name: Claim
definition: Traceable extracted assertion with verification status

name: ETF
definition: 指數股票型基金或其他在交易所交易的基金。成分股資料有明確基準日與權重來源，不代表個人持倉。 / Exchange-traded funds. Constituent snapshots have an as-of date and a weight source; they do not represent personal holdings.

name: Service
definition: Sellable service such as foundry, testing, packaging subcontracting, design or system integration

name: Offering
definition: Anything a company sells: a Product or a Service. Abstract parent class; relations that accept an Offering accept both.
